query:
-- Step 1: Reset all isFreePreview to false for photos in VIP albums
UPDATE photos p
INNER JOIN albums a ON p.albumId = a.id
SET p.isFreePreview = 0
WHERE a.isVip = 1;

-- Step 2: Set isFreePreview = true for the first 5 photos (by sortOrder, createdAt) per VIP album
UPDATE photos p
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT p2.id
  FROM photos p2
  INNER JOIN albums a2 ON p2.albumId = a2.id
  WHERE a2.isVip = 1
    AND (
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photos p3
      WHERE p3.albumId = p2.albumId
        AND (p3.sortOrder < p2.sortOrder OR (p3.sortOrder = p2.sortOrder AND p3.createdAt < p2.createdAt) OR (p3.sortOrder = p2.sortOrder AND p3.createdAt = p2.createdAt AND p3.id < p2.id))
    ) < 5
) ranked ON p.id = ranked.id
SET p.isFreePreview = 1;
